# dify_app (Resource)

Manages a Dify application via DSL YAML. The app lifecycle (create, update, delete) is driven by the DSL content imported through the workspace OpenAPI. Only `workflow` and `advanced-chat` apps support in-place DSL overwrite; changes to apps of any other mode require replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage a Dify application from its exported DSL YAML.
# Export the DSL from the Dify console (or GET /openapi/v1/apps/<id>/dsl),
# then point dsl_yaml at the file.
resource "dify_app" "my_workflow" {
  dsl_yaml    = file("${path.module}/my-workflow.yaml")
  name        = "My Workflow"
  description = "A workflow managed by Terraform"

  # Publish the imported draft (workflow/advanced-chat apps only)
  publish = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dsl_yaml` (String) DSL YAML content defining the app (desired state). Changes trigger a DSL re-import; for non-workflow app modes this forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) App description. Overrides the DSL description when set.
- `name` (String) App name. Overrides the name in the DSL when set.
- `publish` (Boolean) Publish the imported draft as a new version and make the app use it (POST /apps/{id}:publish) after every create/update import. Leave false to keep the app on its last published version; the draft is still imported either way. Only `workflow` and `advanced-chat` apps have drafts — other modes are live as soon as the import lands, so `publish` is ignored for them.
- `service_api_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app's Service API is on (PATCH /apps/{id}/service-api, or /service-api/agent when mode is `agent`). When set to `true`, create/update apply it after the import; read refreshes it from the server. Setting `false` is rejected: this server's app management calls (DSL export, publish, versions) require the Service API, so a disabled API would make Read/Update fail.

### Read-Only

- `draft_hash` (String) Hash of the app's current draft, returned by the DSL export. Passed back on overwrite imports so concurrent draft edits are refused.
- `exported_dsl_yaml` (String) The DSL YAML exported from the live app (actual state). May differ from dsl_yaml due to server-side normalization.
- `id` (String) App ID (assigned by Dify).
- `mode` (String) App mode (e.g. `chat`, `workflow`, `agent-chat`), read from the exported DSL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Apps are imported by their app ID (visible in the Dify console URL).
terraform import dify_app.example <app_id>
```
